english.title: Attempt to obtain pecuniary advantage by deception for self
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to dishonestly obtain for yourself a pecuniary advantage, by deception namely by falsely representing that **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF THE DECEPTION..) in order to

(A)_[be allowed to borrow by way of overdraft from **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(B)_[be allowed to take out a policy of insurance with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(C)_[be allowed to take out an annuity contract with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(D)_[obtain an improvement in the terms on which you were allowed to borrow by way of overdraft from **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(E)_[obtain an improvement in the terms on which you were allowed to take out a policy of insurance with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(F)_[obtain an improvement in the terms on which you were allowed to take out an annuity contract with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)]_
(G)_[be given the opportunity to earn remuneration or greater remuneration in an office or employment]_
(H)_[be given the opportunity to win money by betting]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
